title: Slice
author: Rich Samuels
description: A serial killer texts Colin and informs him that he will be the next victim. Colin isn’t convinced at first, but the killer seems to know a little too much about him…and where he is.

messages.text: You’re the one I’m cutting next.
Jack, is that you? This is a stupid joke.
I’m going to slice you into little tiny pieces.
I’m very good at it. Slicing, I mean.
I’m just waiting for the just the right time…
And then I’ll start my work.
I thought you understood by now. I will slice you.
I’ll know it when I see it.
For example, I wouldn’t start right now, while you’re at the supermarket.
PIC OF COLIN (age: 18-22) AT THE SUPERMARKET
And the gas station you just left was too crowded.
If you’re roommates Tom and Alan aren’t home, maybe I’ll do it when you get home.
Okay this has gone far enough. Jack, is that you?
If I don’t know you, why would you want to slice me up?
You look like you could use slicing.
You’re really looking at produce here?
The produce is not very good, just to let you know.
I think you’ve really overfilled your shopping cart, anyway.
I think you’ve done enough food shopping for today.
Why are you looking at that old lady? Do you think I could be her?
If you think I believe you’re some serial killing, you’re wrong.
I don’t know if “serial killer” would be the right description.
It’s not a good idea to pay for your groceries on your credit card.
I’m just trying to give you a little bit of advice.
Why, if you’re going to kill me?
You’ve been in the supermarket a long time.
Can you believe it’s already dark outside?
I love this time of the year.
Too bad they haven’t turned on the lights in the parking lot.
Well, it’s good for me, obviously
My car has lights. It’s not like I’m in total darkness.
True, but you still can’t see what might come out at you from the dark.
The moon isn’t even out tonight.
And really, I don’t need that much time to do my work.
And I can tell, you’re the kind where the meat will slide right off the bone.
I guess you can say I’m somewhat of an expert.
Now look at that, you’ve almost filled up your trunk with groceries. And you still have more!
You can probably make a little bit more room…just reach back in there.
